description: Run opt-in structured rubric checks through an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/decisions` decision model or `/v1/chat/completions` fallback. Use when a parent workflow or operator explicitly opts in to fast predicate, choice, or score triage across bundled presets (claim-audit, ci-triage, tool-risk, skill-review, memory-curation, pr-feedback-triage, citation-entailment, model-escalation, spec-readiness). Not a substitute for deterministic gates, artifact inspection, or primary agent sign-off. Use rubric-tune for iterative rubric optimization.
